Items: a latte (~12 oz, whole milk, about 150 kcal), an egg and cheese muffin sandwich (about 300 kcal), 2 slices of whole grain toast (about 160 kcal), peanut butter (about 100 kcal for a 15 g packet), jam (about 35 kcal), and sugar (about 15 kcal for a 4 g packet).

Served total: 150 + 300 + 160 + 100 + 35 + 15 = 760 kcal.

The photo shows the meal before eating, so I have to guess what will be left over. Packets are often left unused, so I assume the sugar and some of the jam stay behind, about 30 kcal in total. Leftover is about 30 kcal, so the person eats about 730 kcal.

Macronutrient estimate for what is eaten:
- Protein: latte 8 g, egg sandwich 15 g, toast 7 g, peanut butter 4 g, giving about 34 g.
- Carbohydrate: latte 12 g, sandwich 28 g, toast 28 g, peanut butter 4 g, jam 8 g, giving about 80 g.
- Fat: latte 8 g, sandwich 17 g, toast 2 g, peanut butter 8 g, giving about 35 g.
